title: Hrithik Roshan Has No Film in 2026. He's Never Been More in Demand.
excerpt: The Chhaava director just pitched him a script. Rajinikanth already shot with him. Krrish 4 is quietly coming alive. And Hombale wants to build an empire around him.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Hrithik Roshan has no films scheduled for 2026 despite high industry demand.
  • He is focusing on reinvention rather than immediate visibility in cinema.
  • Krrish 4 is in pre-production with Hrithik directing for the first time.
  • Hrithik is collaborating with Hombale Films for a large-scale pan-India project.
  • His production company is developing content for streaming platforms like Amazon Prime Video.
Here is the strange paradox of **Hrithik Roshan** in 2026: the year's busiest release calendar in a decade, and Bollywood's reigning Greek God is nowhere on it. No theatrical release. No streaming premiere with his name above the title. In a year where **Dhurandhar** crossed ₹3,300 crore, **Cocktail 2** and **Alpha** battled for screens, and every other star seems to have at least two projects in the pipeline, Hrithik has opted for something far more interesting than visibility. He's opted for reinvention. https://youtube.com/watch?v=czxNbT2t7Ts And the industry can't stop knocking on his door. ## Laxman Utekar Comes Calling The latest name in Hrithik's orbit is **Laxman Utekar** — the man who directed **Chhaava**, one of the biggest Hindi blockbusters of recent years, and is currently awaiting the release of **Eetha**, a biographical drama starring Shraddha Kapoor. According to a report by *Variety India*, Utekar recently narrated a script to Hrithik, who responded positively but has yet to commit. No deal has been signed, no announcement made. But the meeting itself tells a story: when the hottest director in Hindi cinema is ready for his next, Hrithik is the first call. For Utekar, the trajectory has been remarkable — from the breezy charm of *Luka Chuppi* and *Mimi* to the sweeping period grandeur of Chhaava. A collaboration with Hrithik would mark a significant escalation in scale and ambition, and on paper, it's the kind of pairing that makes trade analysts salivate. > **"No deal has been signed, no announcement made."** ## Krrish Is Stirring Behind the scenes, the project that still dominates Hrithik's headspace is **Krrish 4** — India's original superhero franchise, returning after a twelve-year hiatus from *Krrish 3*. The twist this time: Hrithik is stepping behind the camera for the first time as director. ![Greek God — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/24/Sculptures_du_Parth%C3%A9non_%28British_Museum%29_%288706164279%29.jpg) Backed by **Yash Raj Films**, Krrish 4 is currently deep in pre-production, with the team investing heavily in next-generation VFX and a complete narrative reimagining. Sources close to the project say the extended timeline is deliberate — the film is being built to meet global standards, and Hrithik has no intention of rushing it. For a franchise that effectively invented Indian superhero cinema, the fourth chapter carries enormous expectations. And the man who created the mask is now shaping the story behind it. ## The Hombale Connection and Rajinikanth's Call Hrithik is also committed to a large-scale pan-India film with **Hombale Films**, the production house behind the *KGF* franchise and *Kantara*. Both parties have publicly described the project as "a cinematic experience where intensity meets imagination on a grand scale" — the kind of language studios reserve for budgets that make accountants nervous.
Hrithik's Upcoming Projects
›Krrish 4: India's original superhero franchise returning after 12 years.
›Hombale Films: Large-scale pan-India film in collaboration.
›Rajinikanth's Jailer 2: Hrithik's cameo shot in June 2023.
›Streaming: HRX Films developing 'Storm' and 'Mess' for Amazon Prime.
And then there's the most delicious cameo of the season: Hrithik flew to Chennai on **June 22-23** to shoot a pivotal appearance in **Rajinikanth's Jailer 2**. When Thalaivar calls, you show up. The specifics of his role remain under wraps, but his presence in the sequel confirms a willingness to appear in the right projects — even when he's not leading them. Smart, strategic, and a little thrilling. ## The Streaming Play While theatrical projects simmer, Hrithik's production banner **HRX Films** has been building a streaming portfolio with **Amazon Prime Video**. The thriller drama series **Storm**, created by Ajitpal Singh and featuring Parvathy Thiruvothu and Alaya F, is in development. A comedy film called **Mess** is gearing up for production with a premise insiders describe as "refreshingly original." It's a sharp strategic move — building a content pipeline as a producer while waiting for the right starring vehicles to crystallize. ## The Method to the Absence What Hrithik is doing isn't disappearing. It's recalibrating. The underperformance of **War 2** left a mark — not at the box office alone, but on his entire approach to choosing projects. The days of signing films on momentum are over. Every script meeting runs against a higher bar, every commitment measured against the time and energy it demands.
The Shift in Strategy
›No films in 2026 despite a busy release calendar.
›Focus on quality over quantity in project selection.
›Recalibrating after the underperformance of War 2.
›Higher standards for script meetings and commitments.
For the diaspora audience that grew up on *Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai* and *Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara*, the wait is real. But so is the promise: when Hrithik does return to the screen, it won't be with something forgettable. He's just making absolutely sure of that first.
